scope.summary: Replaced scheduler-sensitive Rekor outage stopwatches with gated state proofs that directly verify enqueue and durable audit append return while the external submitter remains blocked.
out_of_scope: production Rekor queue behavior, which was unchanged
live submission to a public Rekor service

entry_points.name: gated Rekor outage regression tests
entry_points.trace: Both focused Rekor outage tests passed, followed by all 250 oraclemcp-audit unit tests. The closed gate makes an unfinished external submission observable, so returned enqueue and durable append results prove isolation without a micro-latency proxy.

entry_points.name: full local pre-push qualification
entry_points.trace: Pinned fmt, workspace all-target clippy and tests, cargo deny, architecture fitness, honesty, workflow supply-chain, Node 22 dashboard checks, production bundle/SBOM, and all 3 Chromium workflows passed. Changed-line coverage against d90bd808204726acd699982aec465fc490af8d1a covered 30/30 changed oraclemcp-audit lines; the mutation leg remained explicitly deferred under the existing train policy, not claimed as passed.

entry_points.name: exact-SHA hosted CI
entry_points.trace: GitHub Actions CI run 30340105460 on source 31dbd391cd29ef489ff309a07ca826882496b0d8 completed success with 23/23 jobs and zero failures. Both pinned cargo test and floating-nightly workspace all-target tests passed.

limitations: The repair changes test synchronization only; it does not claim a new production Rekor capability.
Hosted CI exercises the bounded asynchronous worker with deterministic test submitters, not a public Rekor endpoint.
